title: Gloss Surface Document
description: One authored native screen slot at plugins/Gloss/surfaces/<id>.json: an action bar segment, a boss bar or a title, selected per viewer and delivered through the shared VolmLib HUD compositor.

schemaVersion.description: Document format version. Files on any other version are ignored.

revision.description: Server-owned monotonic revision, bumped on every write.

surface.description: Which native screen slot this document drives.

show.description: Condition deciding whether this document is eligible for a viewer at all. A boolean or a boolean expression.

select.title: Surface Selection
select.description: How this document competes with the other documents of the same surface kind. Highest priority wins, ties break by lowest id.

when.description: Condition deciding whether this document wants the slot for a viewer.

presentation.title: Surface Presentation
presentation.description: What this surface shows. Which fields apply depends on the document's surface: actionbar uses text and slots, bossbar uses title, progress, color and style, title uses title, subtitle, the fade timings and trigger.

text.description: Action bar text. Runs through the full text pipeline for the viewer.

slots.description: Compositor slots this action bar segment may occupy. The compositor merges segments from every plugin into one line.

title.description: Boss bar title, or the title line for a title surface. Runs through the full text pipeline for the viewer.

subtitle.description: Subtitle line for a title surface. Omitted means no subtitle.

progress.description: Boss bar fill as a number expression, clamped to 0..1. Evaluated for the viewer on every refresh.

priority.description: Compositor priority this surface bids with. Higher priorities win the slot; Gloss surfaces default to status so a pregen progress bar or a modal title still wins.

ttlTicks.description: Ticks this surface stays asserted before the compositor drops it. Omitted means twice the [surfaces] refreshIntervalTicks.

fadeInTicks.description: Ticks a title fades in over.

stayTicks.description: Ticks a title stays fully visible.

fadeOutTicks.description: Ticks a title fades out over.

trigger.description: When a title fires: select on the pass where the document becomes selected, once per session, or repeat while it stays selected.

repeatTicks.description: Ticks between repeats for a repeat trigger. Clamped to at least stayTicks so a title never fights its own fade.

variants.description: Alternative presentations for the same document. The highest-priority variant whose condition matches replaces the base presentation; variants never merge.

id.description: Variant id, unique inside this document.

priority.description: Variant priority; higher wins, ties break by lowest id.

when.description: Condition deciding whether this variant applies for the viewer.
